result.instructions: Tools for Bedrijfsrooster, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on the timetable next week?"; "Which employees have an availability gap on Friday?"; "List the employment contracts that are active today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bedrijfsrooster data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bedrijfsrooster_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bedrijfsrooster_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bedrijfsrooster_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bedrijfsrooster_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_get_configuration
tools.title: Get company configuration
tools.description: Get the company this access token belongs to: its id and name, its group, and its locations, departments, functions and shift types. Call this first. The ids it returns are the filters for the other tools. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /configuration.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_list_users
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees (CompanyUsers) with an active or future employment in the company, optionally within a period. Set extendedDetails only when the user asks for personal details: it adds birthday, email and address. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /users.

periodStart.description: Only employees with an active contract on or after this date.

periodEnd.description: Only employees with an active contract on or before this date.

snapshotDate.description: Date for date-bound computed fields. Default: today, or periodEnd.

extendedDetails.description: Add personal details (birthday, email, address). Default false.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_list_contracts
tools.title: List employment contracts
tools.description: List the contracts between the company and its employees that are active at the snapshot date or within a period. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /contracts.

periodStart.description: Only contracts on or after this date.

periodEnd.description: Only contracts on or before this date.

snapshotDate.description: Date for date-bound computed fields. Default: today, or periodEnd.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_list_timetable
tools.title: List timetable shifts
tools.description: List the shifts of the company timetable: scheduled work shifts, availability, relief (vacation, days off) and non-attendance (sick days, no-shows). Choose which kinds to include with the shifts* flags. The reply is paged: use pageIndex (from 1) and itemsPerPage (1 to 1000), or disablePaging for a single reply. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /timetable.

updatedAfter.description: Only shifts whose timetable data changed after this date-time.

shiftsAvailable.description: Include availability overrides set by employees.

shiftData.description: Attach the shift data items that management or employees registered.

companyUserId.description: Only shifts of this employee id.

companyLocationId.description: Only shifts at this location id.

companyFunctionId.description: Only shifts of this function id.

companyDepartmentId.description: Only shifts of this department id.

disablePaging.description: Return one reply without paging. Use only for small periods.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_get_report
tools.title: Get a finished report
tools.description: Get the stored result of one finished Bedrijfsrooster report by its reportId, for example the relief hours balance. A report that is still running returns HTTP 409 with its percentage_complete: call again later. Needs the company:reports:read integration permission. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /reports.

reportId.description: The report id as the Bedrijfsrooster app shows it.

tools.name: bedrijfsrooster_get_availability
tools.title: Get availability
tools.description: Get the availability (beschikbaarheid) per date, for each employee (companyUser) or each function (companyFunction). Use periodStart and periodEnd together, within one month (up to 31 days). Needs the company:availability:read integration permission. Bedrijfsrooster API: GET /availability.

entity.description: companyUser: hours per employee and date. companyFunction: headcount per function and date.

periodStart.description: First date. Give periodEnd too. Default: first day of this month.

periodEnd.description: Last date. Give periodStart too. Default: last day of this month.
